title: Blueprint
pitch: The report as one zoomable engineering drawing: zoom out for labelled regions, in for summaries, closer for full detail.
bestFor: Research where the relationships between parts are the point (system architectures, build-vs-buy, ecosystem maps), for readers who explore rather than read top to bottom.
weakness: Pan and zoom is slower than scrolling for linear reading, and each region needs both a summary layer and a detail layer; phone readers often switch to the list view.
signals: many distinct parts whose relationships matter
an architecture or system diagram is the centrepiece
build vs buy with components and effort
8–20 sections that can stand side by side
disagreements between sources to flag in place
avoid: an argument meant to be read top to bottom
short reports with fewer than about 5 sections
readers who will mostly be on phones
